comparison.objective: Clip an IV tube to a mattress while leaving a specified slack loop; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: IV task tests deformable routing, snap-in clipping, and tension/slack management; candidate tests rigid coaxial tool alignment, hammering, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Tube must be clipped with 5–15 cm excess length, hub undisturbed, and tube released; candidate requires four fractures, no coil or shell damage, and full tang containment.
comparison.reason: Deformable cable routing and slack control are meaningfully different from impact-driven metal-notch fracture.
